title: Digital Artist & Concept Illustrator
tagline: Exploring atmospheric narratives, character soul, and creature design through digital painting.
bio: I am an independent concept artist and illustrator focused on cinematic character design, evocative storytelling, and exploratory digital painting. My work oscillates between quiet atmospheric moments and high-intensity dynamic concepts, always seeking honesty in gesture, lighting, and textural rendering.
statement: Art is a lens through which we render the unspoken. Every stroke balances shape language, value hierarchy, and emotional resonance to breathe life into imagined worlds.
